Complete Guide

How to Sell Gold — and Where to Sell Gold for the Fairest Value

You have more options for selling gold than you may realise — your old jeweller, a bank, an online buyer, a dedicated gold-buying store — and they do not pay the same. This guide explains how to sell gold step by step, compares where to sell gold honestly, and ends with a checklist you can use at any counter, including ours.

📞 Call +91 99532 11815 💬 WhatsApp Us 📍 Get Directions

How to Sell Gold — The 5 Steps

Step 1 — Prepare. Collect everything you might sell, including broken and single pieces, plus one photo ID. Step 2 — Know your purity. Get a free XRF test before negotiating anywhere; the karat and net weight are your facts. Step 3 — Get a live-rate valuation. Payout = pure-gold weight × today's rate; check the arithmetic yourself (our rate page shows the formula and purity table). Step 4 — Compare the final figure. Same day, after all deductions — not headline rates. Step 5 — Sell with documentation. Complete KYC, accept instant payment (cash, NEFT or RTGS) and keep the invoice.

Where to Sell Gold — Your Options, Honestly Compared

  • Your local jeweller: convenient and familiar, but buying is a side business. Expect acid testing, wastage/melting deductions, and a push towards exchanging into new jewellery (with fresh making charges) rather than clean cash value. Fine for exchange if the numbers are shown — ask for them.
  • Banks & NBFCs: excellent for gold loans, but they are not walk-in fair-value purchasers of your jewellery; their route is lending against it, with interest and auction risk if you default.
  • Online / mail-in gold buyers: you courier or hand over your gold before the final price is fixed. The valuation happens out of sight; rejecting it means waiting for your gold's return. Convenient for some, but you surrender your strongest protection — watching the test.
  • A dedicated gold-buying store (like ours): buying is the entire business, so the process is built around it — XRF testing in front of you, certified weighing, live-rate calculation shown line by line, instant documented payment, and the freedom to walk away free. This is the option we'd benchmark the others against.

The Seller's Checklist (Use It Anywhere)

  • Purity tested by XRF, on screen, in front of me — not estimated, not in a back room.
  • Weight shown on a certified scale; stones and non-gold parts explained, not silently skipped.
  • Rate = today's live market rate, and I can see the full calculation.
  • All deductions named before I agree — ideally none beyond the formula.
  • Payment instant, in my chosen mode, against a proper invoice with KYC done.
  • Free to walk away at every step without charge or pressure.

Ready When You Are
